8	head/evals/harness/ablation-grade.sh:710 — extract_snapshot() calls `tarfile.data_filter` / `tarfile.FilterError`, and line 714 calls `tf.extractall(tree, filter=keep)`. Both exist only from Python 3.12 (backported in 3.11.4 / 3.10.12).
